messages:
DeployBot: preflight-eval alert for release v3.1.0 -> BLOCKING: route=\"reranker\". precision@10 -11.9%, nDCG -9.4% (n=1200, p<0.005). Promotion paused. full report: https://ci.redwood/evals/3967001111 :rotating_light:
Priya M: thanks. pausing deploy. can someone grab a 5-min triage? we need recommendation (pin vs rollback vs split).
Lea: quick glance — failures look concentrated on long-tail query templates (sessionized summarization prompts) not core search. split traffic to fallback might reduce blast radius.
Tomas: agree. prefer traffic-split to keep improvements for other workloads. what variant is safe fallback? v3.0.7?
QA Bot: uploaded failing examples, and a small canary sample of 200 showing failure clusters = [context-truncation, preference-flip, score-inversion]. fallback baseline v3.0.7 yields stable precision. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/evals/3967001111/fails
OpsBot: note: we have a low-change window in 2h; prefer to avoid full rollback during that window.
Priya M: OK plan proposal: 1) temporary route-split 85/15 (v3.0.7/v3.1.0) for reranker, 2) open INF-4982 to triage with logs+repro, 3) run bisect across model commits and scoring code.
Lea: split command ready: `rwctl route-split --route reranker --from v3.1.0 --to v3.0.7 --weights 85,15 --reason \"preflight reranker regression\"`.
Tomas: let's pin if split shows >5% improvement in precision for the 85% fraction after 10m. otherwise escalate to rollback.
Priya M: create ticket and assign: INF-4982 created, assigned @Lea @Tomas. include reproduction script and failing prompt sample.
Lea: running dry-run then flip: ``rwctl route-split --route reranker --from v3.1.0 --to v3.0.7 --weights 85,15 --dry-run``
Lea: dry-run OK, now applying split...
DeployBot: ACTION: route reranker split applied by Lea at 3967001132. new weights = v3.0.7:85%, v3.1.0:15%. Promotion blocked for reranker until triage signoff.
QA Bot: quick monitor: after split (10m) precision@10 improved on target sample by +7.3% relative to full v3.1.0. no latency regressions. monitoring link: https://ci.redwood/monitor/3967001132
Tomas: good. leaving pin option open. if bisect identifies a model change in 3.1.0 commit range we should pin route to v3.0.7 until hotfix.
Priya M: to confirm process for release notes: I'll append a short note under release draft: "reranker route held to v3.0.7 pending triage for precision regression on long-tail prompts" and ping support + PMs.
Lea: running bisect: `rwctl bisect --suite reranker-longtail --from v3.0.7 --to v3.1.0 --parallel 4 --samples 300`
Lea: bisect initial result: regression narrowed to commit 1a2b3c4 -> scoring change in ranking-loss scaling. tagging @models for a targeted revert/hotfix.
Tomas: if it's scoring scaling, we can rebuild scoring profile or apply a conditional override to long-tail requests. open to targeted patch instead of full rollback.
Priya M: decision for now: maintain split (85/15), open hotfix PR for scoring-scaling revert, target canary behind pin once ready. update INF-4982 with bisect result and action items.
DeployBot: NOTE: reranker route marked as "conditional-split"; promotion of v3.1.0 blocked for that route. other routes continue.
QA Bot: sanity check after split: error rate steady, user-facing metric safe. will run extended eval overnight.
Lea: adding quick grep to repo for recent scoring changes: `git log --pretty=oneline --stat v3.0.7..v3.1.0 | grep scoring || true`
Priya M: thanks team. follow-ups: post hotfix PR link here and request re-eval. aim to resolve before change window ends. :raised_hands:
